_comment: Curated recurring small-business grant programs and watch pages. type 'listing' entries are known programs checked against their page; type 'watch' entries are pages scanned for new grant announcements. Verify current status on the linked page before drafting — programs open and close throughout the year.

sources.name: Maryland Department of Commerce - Funding Programs
sources.notes: State funding programs for Maryland businesses. Watch for small business and rural business programs.

sources.name: Frederick County Office of Economic Development
sources.notes: County-level business assistance, occasional grant and microloan programs for Frederick County businesses.

sources.name: TEDCO (Maryland Technology Development Corporation)
sources.notes: Mostly tech-focused but runs rural and pre-seed programs occasionally open to service businesses.

sources.name: Hello Alice Small Business Grants
sources.notes: Aggregator of corporate small-business grant programs; frequently rotating $5k-$25k awards.

sources.name: Verizon Small Business Digital Ready Grants
sources.eligibility: US small businesses that complete free Digital Ready courses
sources.notes: Requires completing 2 free online courses to unlock grant application. Good fit for owner-operated service businesses.

sources.name: USDA Rural Development - Business Programs (Maryland)
sources.notes: Rural business development grants (RBDG) usually flow through intermediaries, but Value-Added and microenterprise assistance programs can reach small rural businesses. Thurmont-area businesses may qualify as rural.

sources.name: SBA Maryland District Office
sources.notes: SBA rarely grants directly to for-profits but announces state/local programs and lender events worth tracking.

sources.name: Skip / other rotating small business grant lists
